questions.question: A fictional accountancy wants a clearer appointment reminder. What is a suitable first use of ChatGPT?

answers.text: Ask it to choose the client’s tax treatment.
answers.feedback: Tax treatment needs the responsible qualified person and authoritative information.

answers.text: Supply fictional appointment facts and review its email draft.
answers.feedback: This is a small drafting task where you can compare the answer with supplied facts.

answers.text: Paste a complete real client file for background.
answers.feedback: Use the course’s fictional material. A full client file exposes unnecessary information.

answers.text: Accept any dates that make the email look complete.
answers.feedback: A complete-looking draft can contain invented dates. Keep unknown details visible.

questions.feedback: This is a small drafting task where you can compare the answer with supplied facts.

questions.question: Your personal account has Improve the model for everyone turned off. What should you expect?

answers.text: All old chats and saved memories are deleted.
answers.feedback: The training setting does not delete stored chats or separate memories.

answers.text: Any client file is now approved for uploading.
answers.feedback: Your organisation must still approve data use. An opt-out is not permission.

answers.text: New conversations are not used to train models, but can remain in history.
answers.feedback: The setting changes model improvement for new conversations; history is separate.

answers.text: The account has become a managed Business workspace.
answers.feedback: A personal setting does not change the account’s plan or create a workspace.

questions.feedback: The setting changes model improvement for new conversations; history is separate.

questions.question: Which plan distinction should a manager understand before buying?

answers.text: Plus automatically provides the same organisation controls as Enterprise.
answers.feedback: Plus is an individual plan. Enterprise is an organisation offering with more advanced controls.

answers.text: ChatGPT Business is the current name for ChatGPT Team and requires at least two seats.
answers.feedback: The Team plan was renamed Business. Current Business setup needs two Standard or Premium seats in total.

answers.text: Using a personal plan at work turns it into Business.
answers.feedback: Work use alone does not change the plan. Confirm the actual account and workspace.

answers.text: Free access guarantees unlimited file uploads.
answers.feedback: Free uploads have limits. Use the text alternatives when needed.

questions.feedback: The Team plan was renamed Business. Current Business setup needs two Standard or Premium seats in total.

questions.question: Select all suitable setup actions for this course.

answers.text: Confirm the account or workspace your employer approves.
answers.feedback: Start with the approved account and information rules.

answers.text: Review both model-improvement and memory controls.
answers.feedback: Training and memory controls have different purposes.

answers.text: Use Temporary chat as permission to paste confidential records.
answers.feedback: Temporary chat does not override your employer’s rules or privacy duties.

answers.text: Use fictional practice data even after changing settings.
answers.feedback: Fictional material keeps the beginner exercise away from real personal or confidential data.

questions.feedback: Start with the approved account and information rules. Training and memory controls have different purposes. Fictional material keeps the beginner exercise away from real personal or confidential data.

questions.question: Match each control or account type with its purpose.
questions.feedback: Training, personalization, and workspace administration are separate. Review each for your intended use.

answers.matchText: Controls whether eligible new conversations help train models
Manage information used to personalise answers
Provides a managed environment for a team
